list: The official 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden

trophies.guide: 1. Earn the other 54 trophies first; the platinum unlocks automatically the moment the last one pops. 2. Follow the Roadmap tab in order: story first, then stranger strands, then activities and counts, then money and robberies, then exploration and oddities, and finally the 100% cleanup. 3. Keep the Missables tab open while you play the story so no one-time trophy slips past before the finale.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies first; the platinum unlocks automatically the moment the last one pops.
Follow the Roadmap tab in order: story first, then stranger strands, then activities and counts, then money and robberies, then exploration and oddities, and finally the 100% cleanup.
Keep the Missables tab open while you play the story so no one-time trophy slips past before the finale.

trophies.guide: 1. Play the opening mission Gone Fishing from the start of the story; it is the first mission of Chapter 1. 2. Follow the on-screen objectives and the mission markers until the mission completes. 3. The trophy pops on the mission-complete screen; it cannot be missed because the story always passes through it.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing from the start of the story; it is the first mission of Chapter 1.
Follow the on-screen objectives and the mission markers until the mission completes.
The trophy pops on the mission-complete screen; it cannot be missed because the story always passes through it.

trophies.guide: 1. Play through every story mission of Chapter 1 in order until the chapter-end cutscene plays. 2. Check the pause menu progress screen to see which Chapter 1 missions remain if you are unsure. 3. The trophy unlocks when the chapter closes; no side content is needed for it.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play through every story mission of Chapter 1 in order until the chapter-end cutscene plays.
Check the pause menu progress screen to see which Chapter 1 missions remain if you are unsure.
The trophy unlocks when the chapter closes; no side content is needed for it.

trophies.guide: 1. Finish all story missions of Chapter 2, including its mission trophies Breakfast Run and The Cartel Heist. 2. Do the missable mission trophies inside this chapter before moving on, as listed on the Missables tab. 3. The trophy pops when the Chapter 2 finale mission completes.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Finish all story missions of Chapter 2, including its mission trophies Breakfast Run and The Cartel Heist.
Do the missable mission trophies inside this chapter before moving on, as listed on the Missables tab.
The trophy pops when the Chapter 2 finale mission completes.

trophies.guide: 1. Play through every story mission of Chapter 3 in order. 2. Watch for the mission trophies tied to this chapter's missions, such as Child's Play and Headliners, and earn them as you go. 3. The trophy unlocks on the chapter-end screen.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play through every story mission of Chapter 3 in order.
Watch for the mission trophies tied to this chapter's missions, such as Child's Play and Headliners, and earn them as you go.
The trophy unlocks on the chapter-end screen.

trophies.guide: 1. Finish all story missions of Chapter 4, including VCIA Takedown and Operation Savage Glory. 2. This is the last chapter before the finale, so clear any open missable trophies now. 3. The trophy pops when Chapter 4 closes.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Finish all story missions of Chapter 4, including VCIA Takedown and Operation Savage Glory.
This is the last chapter before the finale, so clear any open missable trophies now.
The trophy pops when Chapter 4 closes.

trophies.guide: 1. Complete Chapters 1 to 4 to unlock the final mission. 2. Play the final mission to its end; the gold trophy pops on completion. 3. Save before the finale if you want to keep a pre-ending save for cleanup, since free roam continues after the credits.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Complete Chapters 1 to 4 to unlock the final mission.
Play the final mission to its end; the gold trophy pops on completion.
Save before the finale if you want to keep a pre-ending save for cleanup, since free roam continues after the credits.

trophies.guide: 1. Start the story mission Breakfast Run when its marker appears in Chapter 2. 2. Follow the mission objectives to the end without failing the scripted beats. 3. MISSABLE: mission trophies only pop on a successful run of that mission, so finish Breakfast Run in the story flow; replay it from the mission list if you fail it.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Start the story mission Breakfast Run when its marker appears in Chapter 2.
Follow the mission objectives to the end without failing the scripted beats.
MISSABLE: mission trophies only pop on a successful run of that mission, so finish Breakfast Run in the story flow; replay it from the mission list if you fail it.

trophies.guide: 1. Reach The Cartel Heist mission in Chapter 2 and play it through to the getaway. 2. Stick to the heist plan the game lays out: grab the take, lose the heat, reach the drop-off. 3. MISSABLE: finish the heist in the story flow; if the mission fails, replay it from the mission list before moving past Chapter 2.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist mission in Chapter 2 and play it through to the getaway.
Stick to the heist plan the game lays out: grab the take, lose the heat, reach the drop-off.
MISSABLE: finish the heist in the story flow; if the mission fails, replay it from the mission list before moving past Chapter 2.

trophies.guide: 1. Start the story mission Child's Play when its marker appears in Chapter 3. 2. Complete every objective the mission gives you, including any escort or defense beat. 3. MISSABLE: mission trophies only pop on a successful run, so complete Child's Play in the story flow and replay it from the mission list if it fails.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Start the story mission Child's Play when its marker appears in Chapter 3.
Complete every objective the mission gives you, including any escort or defense beat.
MISSABLE: mission trophies only pop on a successful run, so complete Child's Play in the story flow and replay it from the mission list if it fails.

trophies.guide: 1. Start the story mission Headliners when its marker appears in Chapter 3. 2. Play through the mission's set pieces to the end. 3. MISSABLE: complete Headliners in the story flow; replay it from the mission list if it fails.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Start the story mission Headliners when its marker appears in Chapter 3.
Play through the mission's set pieces to the end.
MISSABLE: complete Headliners in the story flow; replay it from the mission list if it fails.

trophies.guide: 1. Start the story mission VCIA Takedown when its marker appears in Chapter 4. 2. Clear the airport objectives and escape as directed. 3. MISSABLE: finish VCIA Takedown in the story flow; replay it from the mission list if it fails. Do the Catch Me If You Can oddity around the airport while you are here.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Start the story mission VCIA Takedown when its marker appears in Chapter 4.
Clear the airport objectives and escape as directed.
MISSABLE: finish VCIA Takedown in the story flow; replay it from the mission list if it fails. Do the Catch Me If You Can oddity around the airport while you are here.

trophies.guide: 1. Start the story mission Operation Savage Glory when its marker appears in Chapter 4. 2. Complete the operation's combat objectives to the extraction point. 3. MISSABLE: finish it in the story flow; replay it from the mission list if it fails, before you start the final mission.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Start the story mission Operation Savage Glory when its marker appears in Chapter 4.
Complete the operation's combat objectives to the extraction point.
MISSABLE: finish it in the story flow; replay it from the mission list if it fails, before you start the final mission.

trophies.guide: 1. Open the pause menu stats screen and read the 100% checklist: story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles, and exploration. 2. Clear every checklist item; the biggest chunks are the collectible sets, the 52 Leonida areas, and the activity golds. 3. The gold trophy pops the moment the checklist reads 100%; it is the last trophy before the platinum for most players.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Open the pause menu stats screen and read the 100% checklist: story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles, and exploration.
Clear every checklist item; the biggest chunks are the collectible sets, the 52 Leonida areas, and the activity golds.
The gold trophy pops the moment the checklist reads 100%; it is the last trophy before the platinum for most players.

trophies.guide: 1. Stunts count when you land jumps, near misses, long air time, and other stunt moves while driving or riding. 2. Farm them on long highway jumps and stunt ramps: build speed, hit the ramp, land cleanly, and repeat. 3. Track the counter on this card; it climbs across the whole playthrough, so keep stunt-driving between missions instead of grinding all 250 at the end.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Stunts count when you land jumps, near misses, long air time, and other stunt moves while driving or riding.
Farm them on long highway jumps and stunt ramps: build speed, hit the ramp, land cleanly, and repeat.
Track the counter on this card; it climbs across the whole playthrough, so keep stunt-driving between missions instead of grinding all 250 at the end.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: 1. There are 9 activity types in Leonida: the activities behind the other Activity trophies, such as shooting range, drone races, races, fishing, arcade, bowling, and meditation. 2. Play one session of each type; the tracker marks each type as you try it. 3. The trophy pops when the ninth type registers.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: There are 9 activity types in Leonida: the activities behind the other Activity trophies, such as shooting range, drone races, races, fishing, arcade, bowling, and meditation.
Play one session of each type; the tracker marks each type as you try it.
The trophy pops when the ninth type registers.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: 1. Find a Shooting Range and open its challenge list: 42 challenges across its weapon courses. 2. Learn each course's gold time or score target, then replay it until gold; use the weapon the course is built for. 3. Golds are per challenge, so clear the easy courses first and save the hardest for last; the silver pops when all 42 show gold.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Find a Shooting Range and open its challenge list: 42 challenges across its weapon courses.
Learn each course's gold time or score target, then replay it until gold; use the weapon the course is built for.
Golds are per challenge, so clear the easy courses first and save the hardest for last; the silver pops when all 42 show gold.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: 1. Top Fun drone races are marked at 14 locations across Leonida; open the map and visit each race marker. 2. Win a race at a location to check it off; you can retry a location as often as needed. 3. Learn the gates of each course before racing for the win, and finish all 14 locations.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Top Fun drone races are marked at 14 locations across Leonida; open the map and visit each race marker.
Win a race at a location to check it off; you can retry a location as often as needed.
Learn the gates of each course before racing for the win, and finish all 14 locations.

trophies.guide: 1. Races are found at race markers around Leonida; each distinct race counts once when you win it. 2. Enter a new race each time instead of replaying one you already won. 3. The trophy pops on your 20th different race win; combine this with stunt driving between races for Cunning Stunts.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Races are found at race markers around Leonida; each distinct race counts once when you win it.
Enter a new race each time instead of replaying one you already won.
The trophy pops on your 20th different race win; combine this with stunt driving between races for Cunning Stunts.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: 1. Go fishing and take the fishing challenge against Cal when it is offered. 2. Out-fish Cal within the challenge rules: land more or bigger catches before time runs out. 3. MISSABLE: the challenge against Cal is a one-time story-side event, so beat him on your first attempt or replay the strand from your save before it closes.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Go fishing and take the fishing challenge against Cal when it is offered.
Out-fish Cal within the challenge rules: land more or bigger catches before time runs out.
MISSABLE: the challenge against Cal is a one-time story-side event, so beat him on your first attempt or replay the strand from your save before it closes.

trophies.guide: 1. Find an arcade cabinet in Leonida and start any arcade game on it. 2. Play the game through to its end screen; a high score is not required. 3. The trophy pops when the game completes.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade cabinet in Leonida and start any arcade game on it.
Play the game through to its end screen; a high score is not required.
The trophy pops when the game completes.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: 1. Meet Andy through his stranger strand marker and play each of his missions in order. 2. The strand ends with his final mission; complete it to close the strand. 3. Stranger strands stay open in free roam, so finish Andy's strand before the 100% cleanup.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Meet Andy through his stranger strand marker and play each of his missions in order.
The strand ends with his final mission; complete it to close the strand.
Stranger strands stay open in free roam, so finish Andy's strand before the 100% cleanup.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: 1. Meet Kenton through his stranger strand marker and play each of his missions in order. 2. The strand ends with his final mission; complete it to close the strand. 3. Track the strand on the Roadmap tab; it counts toward the 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Meet Kenton through his stranger strand marker and play each of his missions in order.
The strand ends with his final mission; complete it to close the strand.
Track the strand on the Roadmap tab; it counts toward the 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: 1. Meet Billy through his stranger strand marker and play each of his missions in order. 2. The strand ends with his final mission; complete it to close the strand. 3. Billy's strand is one of the 8 needed for Strangers & Freaks, so finish it during the strand stage of the roadmap.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Meet Billy through his stranger strand marker and play each of his missions in order.
The strand ends with his final mission; complete it to close the strand.
Billy's strand is one of the 8 needed for Strangers & Freaks, so finish it during the strand stage of the roadmap.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: 1. Stranger strands are the side missions marked by stranger icons across Leonida; each strand is a chain of missions for one stranger. 2. Complete all missions of a strand to count it; the named strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, and Tyrone are five of the eight. 3. Find three more stranger chains in free roam and finish them; the silver pops on the eighth completed strand.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Stranger strands are the side missions marked by stranger icons across Leonida; each strand is a chain of missions for one stranger.
Complete all missions of a strand to count it; the named strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, and Tyrone are five of the eight.
Find three more stranger chains in free roam and finish them; the silver pops on the eighth completed strand.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: 1. Meet Randy through his stranger strand marker and play each of his missions in order. 2. The strand ends with his final mission; complete it to close the strand. 3. Randy's strand counts toward the 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Meet Randy through his stranger strand marker and play each of his missions in order.
The strand ends with his final mission; complete it to close the strand.
Randy's strand counts toward the 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: 1. Meet Tyrone through his stranger strand marker and play each of his missions in order. 2. The strand ends with his final mission; complete it to close the strand. 3. Tyrone's strand counts toward the 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Meet Tyrone through his stranger strand marker and play each of his missions in order.
The strand ends with his final mission; complete it to close the strand.
Tyrone's strand counts toward the 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: 1. Meditation spots are marked across Leonida; go to a spot and choose to meditate there. 2. Each spot counts once, so visit all 18; the map shows which areas you have not covered yet. 3. Combine the trip with exploring the 52 Leonida areas for The Goodtime State.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: Meditation spots are marked across Leonida; go to a spot and choose to meditate there.
Each spot counts once, so visit all 18; the map shows which areas you have not covered yet.
Combine the trip with exploring the 52 Leonida areas for The Goodtime State.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: 1. Meet Bret through his stranger strand and take the hunting job he offers. 2. Track the unique animal using the hunting clues and take it down cleanly. 3. Return the hunt to Bret to close the job and pop the trophy.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Meet Bret through his stranger strand and take the hunting job he offers.
Track the unique animal using the hunting clues and take it down cleanly.
Return the hunt to Bret to close the job and pop the trophy.

trophies.guide: 1. Collectible Cards are hidden across Leonida; each set is a group of cards found in the world. 2. Pick up cards as you explore and check the collection screen to see which sets are close to complete. 3. Finish any 3 full sets; the silver pops when the third set completes.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Collectible Cards are hidden across Leonida; each set is a group of cards found in the world.
Pick up cards as you explore and check the collection screen to see which sets are close to complete.
Finish any 3 full sets; the silver pops when the third set completes.

trophies.guide: 1. WAiNK It is an activity done at marked locations across Leonida; each location counts once. 2. Visit locations as you explore and do the WAiNK interaction at each one. 3. The counter climbs with exploration, so pair this with the 52-area tour for The Goodtime State; the silver pops at 100 locations.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: WAiNK It is an activity done at marked locations across Leonida; each location counts once.
Visit locations as you explore and do the WAiNK interaction at each one.
The counter climbs with exploration, so pair this with the 52-area tour for The Goodtime State; the silver pops at 100 locations.

trophies.guide: 1. Challenges are the open-world tasks listed in the pause menu challenges screen. 2. Work through the list across combat, driving, and exploration; each completed challenge counts once. 3. The trophy pops at 50 completed challenges; many complete naturally during the other trophies.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Challenges are the open-world tasks listed in the pause menu challenges screen.
Work through the list across combat, driving, and exploration; each completed challenge counts once.
The trophy pops at 50 completed challenges; many complete naturally during the other trophies.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: 1. Bring your partner along, then build a 4-star Wanted Level with police actively chasing you. 2. Break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the stars clear, keeping your partner with you. 3. MISSABLE: the escape must happen with your partner present, so do it while a partner is available in the story flow; a solo escape does not count.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Bring your partner along, then build a 4-star Wanted Level with police actively chasing you.
Break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the stars clear, keeping your partner with you.
MISSABLE: the escape must happen with your partner present, so do it while a partner is available in the story flow; a solo escape does not count.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: 1. Bring your partner, then rob a shop and keep your Wanted Level active. 2. Move straight to a second shop and rob it, then a third, all without losing the Wanted Level in between. 3. MISSABLE: the chain breaks if the heat clears, so plan a route of three close shops and rob them back-to-back with your partner present.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Bring your partner, then rob a shop and keep your Wanted Level active.
Move straight to a second shop and rob it, then a third, all without losing the Wanted Level in between.
MISSABLE: the chain breaks if the heat clears, so plan a route of three close shops and rob them back-to-back with your partner present.

trophies.guide: 1. A vehicle counts as discovered the first time you enter or drive a new model. 2. Drive everything you see: cars, bikes, boats, and aircraft across Leonida. 3. The counter climbs with exploration; the trophy pops at 100 distinct vehicles discovered.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: A vehicle counts as discovered the first time you enter or drive a new model.
Drive everything you see: cars, bikes, boats, and aircraft across Leonida.
The counter climbs with exploration; the trophy pops at 100 distinct vehicles discovered.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: 1. Build up Combat Focus, then trigger it where at least 5 enemies are grouped together. 2. Take down 5 enemies before the focus ends; use a fast weapon and aim for grouped targets. 3. MISSABLE: the five takedowns must land inside one single use, so pick a busy fight and save it for a moment with plenty of enemies on screen.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Build up Combat Focus, then trigger it where at least 5 enemies are grouped together.
Take down 5 enemies before the focus ends; use a fast weapon and aim for grouped targets.
MISSABLE: the five takedowns must land inside one single use, so pick a busy fight and save it for a moment with plenty of enemies on screen.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: 1. Go to VCIA, the Vice City airport, and find a way to leave the airport grounds outside the normal exits. 2. Any unscheduled route out counts: a runway takeoff, a fence hop, or an off-schedule departure the game flags. 3. MISSABLE: do it during the Chapter 4 airport mission window while you are at VCIA, since the airport is easiest to reach then.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to VCIA, the Vice City airport, and find a way to leave the airport grounds outside the normal exits.
Any unscheduled route out counts: a runway takeoff, a fence hop, or an off-schedule departure the game flags.
MISSABLE: do it during the Chapter 4 airport mission window while you are at VCIA, since the airport is easiest to reach then.

trophies.guide: 1. Rhinos are the tanks patrolling high-heat military and police responses; reach 4 stars or more to draw them out. 2. Survive the Rhino encounter the trophy describes: stay mobile, use cover, and avoid the cannon. 3. The trophy pops when the Rhino moment resolves; it is a combat set piece, not a vehicle you need to steal.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Rhinos are the tanks patrolling high-heat military and police responses; reach 4 stars or more to draw them out.
Survive the Rhino encounter the trophy describes: stay mobile, use cover, and avoid the cannon.
The trophy pops when the Rhino moment resolves; it is a combat set piece, not a vehicle you need to steal.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: 1. Pick a jewelry store and plan a quiet entry: go in when the floor is clear and the cameras are not watching. 2. Take the goods without tripping an alarm or being spotted by staff or police. 3. MISSABLE: any detection voids the attempt, so leave and retry the same store if you are spotted; a clean run is what counts.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Pick a jewelry store and plan a quiet entry: go in when the floor is clear and the cameras are not watching.
Take the goods without tripping an alarm or being spotted by staff or police.
MISSABLE: any detection voids the attempt, so leave and retry the same store if you are spotted; a clean run is what counts.

trophies.guide: 1. Bank vaults are found in banks across Leonida; each robbery is a full job with a vault to crack and a getaway. 2. Rob a vault, escape the heat, and bank the take; each completed vault counts once. 3. Repeat at five different banks; the silver pops when the fifth escape succeeds.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Bank vaults are found in banks across Leonida; each robbery is a full job with a vault to crack and a getaway.
Rob a vault, escape the heat, and bank the take; each completed vault counts once.
Repeat at five different banks; the silver pops when the fifth escape succeeds.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: 1. Find an armored truck on the roads of Leonida and stop it. 2. Crack it open, take the cash, and escape the police response. 3. MISSABLE: the escape must succeed after the robbery, so plan your getaway route before you hit the truck.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Find an armored truck on the roads of Leonida and stop it.
Crack it open, take the cash, and escape the police response.
MISSABLE: the escape must succeed after the robbery, so plan your getaway route before you hit the truck.

trophies.guide: 1. Leonida has 52 named areas; the map fills in as you visit each one. 2. Drive the full map in a sweep: Vice City, the beaches, the swamps, the Keys, and the northern towns. 3. Check the map for blank regions and visit them; the trophy pops when the 52nd area registers.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Leonida has 52 named areas; the map fills in as you visit each one.
Drive the full map in a sweep: Vice City, the beaches, the swamps, the Keys, and the northern towns.
Check the map for blank regions and visit them; the trophy pops when the 52nd area registers.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: 1. Each of the 9 gangs runs illegal operations marked around Leonida. 2. Rob one operation per gang; each gang counts once, so spread the jobs across all nine. 3. The trophy pops when the ninth gang's operation is robbed.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Each of the 9 gangs runs illegal operations marked around Leonida.
Rob one operation per gang; each gang counts once, so spread the jobs across all nine.
The trophy pops when the ninth gang's operation is robbed.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: 1. Go to Ocean Beach in Vice City and find a bar or vendor with a view of the water. 2. Order a cocktail and enjoy it at the viewpoint. 3. MISSABLE: the moment is tied to being at Ocean Beach with the right view, so do it while exploring the beachfront early, before the endgame rush.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to Ocean Beach in Vice City and find a bar or vendor with a view of the water.
Order a cocktail and enjoy it at the viewpoint.
MISSABLE: the moment is tied to being at Ocean Beach with the right view, so do it while exploring the beachfront early, before the endgame rush.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: 1. Drive into a vehicle showroom and build speed inside. 2. Smash out through the showroom glass in classic style, as the trophy describes. 3. MISSABLE: the smash must happen inside the showroom, so do it on a visit while showrooms are open in free roam.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Drive into a vehicle showroom and build speed inside.
Smash out through the showroom glass in classic style, as the trophy describes.
MISSABLE: the smash must happen inside the showroom, so do it on a visit while showrooms are open in free roam.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: 1. Find the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in Leonida. 2. Play a full game of bowling there and follow through on your shots. 3. MISSABLE: the game must be played at this specific alley, so do it on your first visit rather than at any other lane.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Find the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in Leonida.
Play a full game of bowling there and follow through on your shots.
MISSABLE: the game must be played at this specific alley, so do it on your first visit rather than at any other lane.

trophies.guide: 1. This is a partnership moment with your partner that the story frames for the public. 2. Play the story scene where the partnership goes public and follow its prompts. 3. MISSABLE: the moment only happens once in the story, so follow the prompts when the scene plays instead of skipping past it.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: This is a partnership moment with your partner that the story frames for the public.
Play the story scene where the partnership goes public and follow its prompts.
MISSABLE: the moment only happens once in the story, so follow the prompts when the scene plays instead of skipping past it.

trophies.guide: 1. PSN tracks a count of choices you make across the game, up to 500. 2. Keep making story and side choices: dialogue picks, mission approaches, and activity choices all count. 3. The counter climbs across the whole playthrough; the trophy pops at 500 choices made.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: PSN tracks a count of choices you make across the game, up to 500.
Keep making story and side choices: dialogue picks, mission approaches, and activity choices all count.
The counter climbs across the whole playthrough; the trophy pops at 500 choices made.

trophies.guide: 1. This trophy is about succeeding on a second attempt after a first failure. 2. When an activity or challenge fails once, retry it immediately and complete it on the second try. 3. MISSABLE: the retry must follow the failure directly, so do not abandon the activity after failing it once.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: This trophy is about succeeding on a second attempt after a first failure.
When an activity or challenge fails once, retry it immediately and complete it on the second try.
MISSABLE: the retry must follow the failure directly, so do not abandon the activity after failing it once.

trophies.guide: 1. This is a random world event: something strange happens in Leonida while you explore. 2. Keep playing in free roam and watch for unusual events, especially at night and in remote areas. 3. MISSABLE: the event is a one-time sighting, so stop and watch when something strange happens instead of driving past it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
